plan: A Noxian general who chains small dashes between her spells and pins her target with her ultimate.
aSurveiller: Her R (Public Execution). She teleports to the farthest enemy in a line and stuns them: don't stand at the end of a line.
contrer: Don't stand at the end of a line of allies: her R targets the farthest one.
Avoid long trades: every spell gives her a dash and an empowered attack.
Use your crowd control after her dashes: she has no escape left.
forces: Very mobile thanks to her small dashes.
Her R pins and stuns a target.
Shield and area damage with her W.
faiblesses: Relies on the energy of her spells.

sorts.P: After each spell, a short dash and an empowered attack.
sorts.Q: Half-circle swing; the next one becomes a strike in a line.
sorts.W: Shield, then slams the ground around her.
sorts.E: Spins her blades and slows nearby enemies.
sorts.R: Teleports to the farthest enemy and stuns them.

momentFort: Held back by long cooldowns in the first levels, she becomes very dangerous once her Q has a few points, and stays strong for a long time.
